description: Renewable Energy Completions and Commitments 2014 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cambridgeshire Insight. Data on the renewable energy completions and commitments in Cambridgeshire for the monitoring year 01/04/2013-31/03/2014. This data is based on planning applications to district councils and the feed in tariff provided by ofgem. Coverage: Cambridgeshire Insight. The portal shows 2025-04-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
